harness_capability.notes: Native UC harness maps ordinary PE sections and runs lifted HIGH functions with import HLE for CRT mem/string and a few x87 helpers. NFSU2 win32/fileio/thread helpers exist in the broader tree but are not wired as the Undercover native UC import path. Atomics suffice for single-thread controlled execution.
